Bike & Chowder Club Rides

Las Cruces, NM · Road · Social

Beginner friendly

Bike & Chowder Club Rides is a road and social group ride in Las Cruces, NM. It rolls sundays and Tuesdays and Thursdays and Saturdays at 8:00 am from Mesilla Plaza. About 15–43 miles, a group 18–20+ mph; B group stay-together 14–18 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Bike & Chowder Club Rides group ride

A Las Cruces recreational riding group going since 1984. No memberships, no dues, one rule: helmets. Most rides end with coffee or food. Four rides a week; times and start points are on the club's schedule page.
